大洋板块内部火山活动受到板块构造和全地幔动力学的强烈影响。

papers.t: Early warnings of earthquakes
tk: A comprehensive overview of the methodologies, challenges, and future prospects of earthquake early warning systems.
对地震预警系统的关键方法、面临挑战及未来前景的系统性综述。

papers.t: Crustal scale heterogeneity across Bhutan Himalayas: insights from local earthquake shear-wave splitting
tk: Local earthquake shear-wave splitting across the Bhutan Himalaya reveals depth-dependent and laterally heterogeneous crustal anisotropy reflecting Main Himalayan Thrust geometry and segmented Indian plate subduction.
不丹喜马拉雅近震横波分裂揭示了随深度和横向剧烈变化的地壳各向异性及俯冲构造差异。

papers.t: Earth’s early history told by 3.9-billion-year-old rocks from northern China
tk: Ancient rocks from northern China show that surface-altered oceanic crust was rapidly buried to >50 km and melted 3.95 billion years ago.
华北古老岩石表明39.5亿年前洋壳曾被深埋至50km以下并熔融。

papers.t: Correction to: Data-space cross-validation of mantle structure in global tomographic models underneath the Pacific Ocean
tk: This is a formal correction to a study evaluating Pacific mantle tomographic models using data-space cross-validation.
该文献是对利用数据空间交叉验证评估太平洋地幔断层成像模型研究的正式勘误。

papers.t: Correction to: A new-generation multiparameter elastic model of the crust and upper mantle of the greater Alpine area and the Apennines using teleseismic full waveform inversion: data, method and models
tk: This is a correction to a study presenting a new-generation multiparameter elastic model of the Alpine crust and upper mantle using teleseismic FWI.
本文是对阿尔卑斯地区远震全波形反演地壳上地幔模型研究的勘误。

papers.t: Correction to: Sedimentary structures of the western part of the Indo-Gangetic Plain and Siwalik Himalaya inferred from receiver function inversion
tk: This document presents a formal correction to a previously published study on receiver function inversion in the Indo-Gangetic Plain.
该文献是对先前发表的关于印度-恒河平原接收函数反演研究的正式勘误。
